Thanks for the call earlier. Please find attached our UK VAT registration certificate (GW-VRN-certificate-2027-04.pdf) and a sample invoice from the UK trading branch. A couple of clarifications below so your finance team can map the PO correctly:

Let me know if you need additional copies or a certified translation.

Anna — thanks for sending these so quickly, appreciate it. I routed the files to finance and tax ops. A few quick follow-ups to make the PO workflow smooth on our end: 

1) Can you confirm the preferred legal entity name that should appear on Redwood PO line (exact match for AP)? You listed both GreenWare Europe Ltd and GreenWare Ltd — which should we use?
2) For multi-currency flows: does GreenWare expect Redwood to net-convert or do you prefer invoices in GBP and our AP team to pay in GBP?
3) Do you have a signed W-8/other withholding docs for the UK entity — (our tax team will note UK is outside US withholding but we still store residency)?

Internal copy: Kimberly, Karthik, Laura — I set a s/route to map the PO to the UK remit entity if Anna confirms. Please advise required fields (VRN on invoice, remit entity, remit email) and whether we need a scanned certificate in the vendor profile.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference

Attachment references: GreenWare files (received)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs: VAT / PO questions (GreenWare Ltd)

Folks — quick notes from tax ops after reviewing the certificate: 

- VRN is valid and formatted correctly (GB999999997). We need the VRN to appear in both the vendor profile and on every invoice to apply reverse-charge logic when applicable.
- Preferred PO mapping: create vendor record for "GreenWare Europe Ltd (UK branch)" and set remit_entity to GreenWare Europe Ltd. Add a secondary legal name field for GreenWare Ltd to support invoices that use that name.
- Currency: ask Anna to invoice in GBP where possible. If they invoice USD, AP will accept but routing requires an explicit bank account mapping — prefer GBP to avoid FX reconciliation.
- Residency proof: store the certificate PDF in vendor profile; signed tax residency affidavit is optional but helpful for audits.

I drafted a PO-routing template (see attached PO-routing-mapping-template.xlsx) with the exact fields we need: vendor_legal_name, remit_entity, vrn, bank_account_id, invoice_currency, remit_email. Karthik — please confirm we can program the vendor onboarding flow to require VRN for EU/UK suppliers.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Tax & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:48:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs: VAT / PO questions (GreenWare Ltd)

Thanks Kim — yes, we can make VRN a required onboarding field for UK/EU vendors. Implementation notes: 

- Vendor API: add validation rule for country == GB or EU countries to require non-empty vrn field and accept pattern ^GB[0-9]{9}$ or standard EU formats.
- UI: add document upload step for VAT certificate (PDF/JPG) and flag vendor as "VAT verified" upon admin approval.
- Routing: PO system needs a mapping so that redwood_core.ap.payments picks remit_entity if invoice_currency == GBP else fallback to primary legal entity. We'll add a QA task to ensure FX accounts are created.

Laura — can you own QA for the routing mapping? Ben — once Anna confirms legal name and currency preference we can uplift in the sandbox and then production.

- Karthik
Engineering Manager, Payments

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the docs and clarifications. Quick confirmation from our side so we can complete onboarding today: 

- Redwood PO name to appear exactly as: "GreenWare Europe Ltd" (this will be the remit entity on the PO).
- Please invoice in GBP where possible. If you must invoice in USD, include the UK bank account details and a note on the invoice about remit_entity.
- We have uploaded GW-VRN-certificate-2027-04.pdf to the vendor profile and set VRN = GB999999997. All invoices must display that VRN.

If everything above is correct, we will issue the initial PO (PO-2027-3211) today and share the DocuSign link for the supplier agreement.
